spec_family.name: Exterior Window Repaint (Combined Assessment + Prep + Prime + Finish)
spec_family.description: Combined prime + finish repaint spec for previously painted exterior window units on residential homes. Covers condition assessment (visual inspect, adhesion test ASTM D3359, chalk test, moisture check sill/bottom rail/end grain, glazing compound assessment, rot probe, sash operation test), prep remediation (power wash per elevation, degloss/scuff, scrape/feather failing/peeling paint, chalk remediation, mildew/algae treatment, caulk assess/repair per 'Think Like a Water Drop' protocol, glazing repair scope-limited <25%, wood hardener, cladding-specific substrate prep), state-driven primer selection (acrylic stain-block for failing/peeling wood, chalk-binding for chalking, DTM spot prime for exposed aluminum, PVC bonding spot prime for exposed vinyl), fine-finish coat application (brush or spray), interstage inspection/sanding between every coat, glass masking (mandatory — 30-40% of total time for TDL), sash blocking prevention for double-hung, and glass scraping after cure. Window unit (frame, sash, muntins) measured in EA with Size Bucket Method (S/M/L). Three cladding types: wood, aluminum-clad, vinyl-clad. EPA lead-safe RRP module for pre-1978 homes (windows are HIGH RISK — friction surfaces). First exterior window RP spec.

includes: Condition assessment (visual inspect with work light/raking light, ASTM D3359 adhesion test, chalk test white cloth rub, moisture check sill/bottom rail/end grain, glazing compound assessment, rot probe, sash operation test)
EPA Lead-Safe RRP evaluation and containment for pre-1978 homes (windows are HIGH RISK for lead paint — friction surfaces on operable sashes are #1 residential lead dust generator)
Low-pressure power wash (500-1000 PSI) per elevation — removes dirt, mildew, chalk residue, loose paint
Degloss/scuff existing sound paint (chemical deglosser or mechanical 150-180 grit)
Scrape and feather failing/peeling paint with carbide scraper and contour scrapers for sash profiles
Chalk remediation pre-treatment for SS_EXT_CHALKING condition before chalk-binding primer
Mildew/algae biocide treatment for affected areas (common on north-facing, shaded, near-ground windows)
Caulk assessment and replacement at frame-to-casing junction per 'Think Like a Water Drop' protocol
Glazing compound spot repair (<25% of perimeter) on older single-pane and TDL wood windows
Wood hardener application on surface-softened areas identified during rot probe assessment
Cladding-specific substrate prep: scuff-sand exposed aluminum (180-220 grit), clean exposed vinyl (TSP/vinyl-safe cleaner)

State-driven primer selection and application (acrylic stain-block for failing/peeling wood, chalk-binding for chalking, corrosion-inhibiting DTM spot prime for exposed aluminum, PVC bonding spot prime for exposed vinyl)
Fine-finish coat application — 2 coats QT3-QT5 (brush or spray)
Interstage inspection, sanding (QT3 none/spot, QT4 220-grit, QT5 hand-sand 220/320), and defect repair between every coat
Glass masking — MANDATORY regardless of method (tape-and-film, liquid mask for TDL non-Low-E, individual pane tape for TDL + Low-E)
Hardware removal/reinstall (labeled bags per window), weatherstripping protection/reinstall
Adjacent surface protection: sill, casing, siding (spray only), landscape/hardscape ground protection
Sash blocking prevention for double-hung: reversal, dry posture, periodic movement, channel lubrication
Glass scraping after cure (razor scrape excess paint beyond 1/16-inch glass lap)
Sash break at 24/48 hrs post-cure to prevent adhesion bond (return visit)
Customer walkthrough with cure advisory (7-14 days before fully closing sashes)

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling inspection rigor, interstage sanding discipline, and edge precision. QT3 is MINIMUM for windows (fine-finish scope). Window QT modifiers use GLOBAL values — NOT door-specific overrides.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT3=1.0x baseline (minimum for windows). QT4=1.3x (global). QT5=1.5x (global). QT2 excluded — exterior windows are visible architectural elements.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique. Brush is default for exterior window RP (precision required for 1/16-inch glass lap, sash sequence). Spray for whole-house spray context (adds masking overhead). Roll is NOT valid for windows.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Brush: default, precision method. Spray: conditional (whole-house spray context, adds siding/casing masking). spray_backroll and roll are NOT valid for windows.

configuration_dimensions.description: Finish coating sheen level. Semi-gloss is traditional/default exterior window sheen. Determines output substrate state.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Semi-gloss: traditional exterior window sheen. Satin: acceptable at QT3. Gloss: QT5 only. Flat/matte/eggshell NOT valid for exterior windows per Fine_Finish_Doctrine.

configuration_dimensions.description: Exterior substrate state classification driving primer selection and prep intensity.
configuration_dimensions.notes: 4 exterior RP substrate states. SOUND_PAINT may skip prime with verified adhesion. CHALKING requires chalk-binding primer. FAILING_PAINT/PEELING require acrylic stain-block primer. Worst-state-wins per v1.

configuration_dimensions.description: Universal 3-level condition scale driving prep intensity modifier. Maps from substrate state assessment.
configuration_dimensions.notes: GOOD=SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT (1.0x prep). FAIR=SS_EXT_CHALKING or SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT (1.5x prep). POOR=SS_EXT_PEELING (2.0x prep).

configuration_dimensions.description: Window cladding material type driving primer chemistry on exposed substrate areas.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Wood: acrylic stain-block primer on exposed areas. Aluminum-clad: DTM corrosion-inhibiting spot primer. Vinyl-clad: PVC bonding spot primer. Cladding determines primer chemistry for exposed areas only.

configuration_dimensions.description: Window operating type affecting task rates via FAC_XWIN_WINDOW_TYPE modifier.
configuration_dimensions.notes: PRIMARY cost driver. fixed=0.50x, awning=0.70x, casement=0.85x, double_hung=1.00x (baseline), bay=2.00x, bow=2.50x.

configuration_dimensions.description: Muntin/grille type affecting masking, painting, and cleanup labor.
configuration_dimensions.notes: SECONDARY cost driver for masking and painting labor. none=1.00x, gbg=1.00x (no painting impact), sdl=1.25x, tdl=1.75x.

configuration_dimensions.description: Window size classification using Size Bucket Method for rate scaling.
configuration_dimensions.notes: S=0.60x (glass area <6 SF). M=1.00x baseline (glass area 6-15 SF). L=1.50x (glass area >15 SF, includes bay/bow).

variants.notes: BASELINE. Most common exterior window repaint. Degloss + scuff + 2 finish coats, no prime. Sound paint with adhesion verified. Brush application.
Standard RP on chalking or failing paint. Scrape/feather or chalk remediation + state-driven prime + 2 finish coats.
Full remediation. Heavy scrape + feather + state-driven prime + 2 finish coats. 2.0x prep modifier.
Premium refresh on sound paint. 220-grit intercoat sand, systematic inspection. No prime.
Premium remediation spray. Full prep + state-driven prime + 2 spray finish coats.
Full remediation spray. Production method with heavy prep, state-driven prime + 2 spray finish coats.
Production cosmetic refresh. Sound paint, spray for speed in whole-house spray context. No prime.
Superior refresh. 2-coat prime for maximum system build on sound paint + 2 finish coats. QT5 interstage.
Superior remediation. 2-coat state-driven prime + 2 finish coats. Maximum primer coverage on degraded surfaces.
Maximum effort. Full remediation + 2-coat prime + 2 finish coats. Near-worst-case labor scenario.
Lead-safe RP. RRP containment + 2.0x prep modifier + state-driven prime + 2 finish coats. Wet scraping methods.

material_systems_summary.name: Acrylic Stain-Blocking Exterior Primer for Wood Windows
material_systems_summary.notes: 100% acrylic exterior stain-blocking primer. Spot prime when bare area <30%; full prime when >=30% or SS_EXT_PEELING. QT5 requires 2 coats.

material_systems_summary.name: Chalk-Binding Conditioner Primer for Exterior Windows
material_systems_summary.notes: MANDATORY for SS_EXT_CHALKING. Penetrates and binds loose chalk residue. Full surface application. All cladding types.

material_systems_summary.name: Corrosion-Inhibiting DTM Spot Primer for Exposed Aluminum
material_systems_summary.notes: Spot prime on exposed bare aluminum areas only. Must scuff-sand before application. Brush only.

material_systems_summary.name: PVC Bonding Spot Primer for Exposed Vinyl
material_systems_summary.notes: MANDATORY on exposed vinyl. Standard primers will NOT bond to vinyl. Recoat within 1 week. Brush only.

material_systems_summary.name: Standard Acrylic Exterior Trim Enamel (QT3)
material_systems_summary.notes: Standard 100% acrylic exterior enamel. UV-resistant. Non-yellowing. 2 coats.

material_systems_summary.name: Modified Urethane Exterior Trim Enamel (QT4)
material_systems_summary.notes: Premium urethane-modified acrylic. Superior flow/leveling/hardness. Blocking resistant. 2 coats.

material_systems_summary.name: Premium Acrylic-Urethane Exterior Trim Enamel (QT5)
material_systems_summary.notes: Premium acrylic-urethane enamel. Maximum durability and hardness. Best blocking resistance. 2 coats.

module_summary.description: Landscape/hardscape ground protection, glass masking (mandatory), hardware removal, weatherstrip protection, sill/casing/siding protection, equipment setup (brush/spray)
Visual condition inspection, adhesion test (ASTM D3359), chalk test (white cloth rub), moisture check, glazing compound assessment (wood), rot probe (wood), sash operation test
Lead screening, containment setup, wet scraping, HEPA vacuum, containment teardown (conditional: pre-1978). Shared module.
Power wash per elevation, degloss/scuff, scrape/feather, chalk remediation, mildew treatment, caulk repair, glazing repair, wood hardener, cladding-specific prep, dust clean
Brush/spray state-driven primer (acrylic stain-block or chalk-binding) + cladding-specific spot prime (DTM aluminum or PVC bonding vinyl)
Intercoat inspection, sand between coats, dust clean, spot repair (runs between every coat pair)
Brush/spray finish coats 1 and 2, muntin detail coats 1 and 2 (SDL/TDL), sash sequence for double-hung (reverse, dry posture, periodic move, lubricate channels)

Final inspection, touch-up, glass scraping, masking removal (3 methods), hardware reinstall, weatherstrip reinstall, sill/casing/siding protection teardown, equipment cleanup, customer walkthrough, cure advisory, sash break (24/48 hr return)

stacking_partition.prep_pool: condition_scale x rrp x access x window_type x muntin x size (max realistic: POOR 2.0 x RRP 2.0 x ground 1.0 x DH 1.0 x none 1.0 x M 1.0 = 4.0x)
stacking_partition.coating_pool: quality_tier x access x window_type x muntin x size (max realistic: QT5 1.5 x ladder 1.35 x DH 1.0 x TDL 1.75 x M 1.0 = 3.54x)
stacking_partition.never_cross: Prep pool never includes QT. Coating pool never includes condition_scale or RRP.

protection_zones_required.notes: MANDATORY regardless of method. Tape-and-film, liquid mask (TDL non-Low-E), or individual pane tape (TDL + Low-E). 1/16-inch glass lap exposed for weather seal.
Hardware REMOVED (not masked). Labeled bags per window. Fixed windows: skip.
Remove friction-fit or deep-tape non-removable. NEVER paint weatherstripping. Fixed windows: skip.
Tape and paper/film over finished exterior sill. RP: sill almost always already finished.
Light tape at casing-to-frame junction. RP: casing almost always already finished.
Paper and tape on siding around window perimeter. Spray only.
RP-specific. Landscape protection below windows. Catches scraping debris, power wash runoff, paint drips. Shared with SF_TRIM_EXT_RP.
RP-specific. Walkway/patio protection. Drop cloth runners. Shared with SF_TRIM_EXT_RP.
EPA RRP Rule. 6-mil poly ground containment extending 10 ft from structure. Per-elevation setup. Shared across all exterior RP specs.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Window casing frames the opening. SF_TRIM_EXT_RP scope. Caulk at frame-to-casing junction is THIS spec's responsibility.
Glass-to-frame edge is the 1/16-inch glass lap weather seal. Glass masking mandatory. Glass scraping after cure.
Exterior sill — may share scope with SF_TRIM_EXT_RP. Protection mandatory in RP.
Siding-to-window junction: casing intervenes. Protection-only for spray method.
Interior window surface — SF_WINDOW_INT_RP scope. No direct adjacency tasks.

valid_input_states.notes: 4 exterior RP substrate states. Each drives distinct prep pathway and primer selection. Worst-state-wins for v1.

output_state.notes: All input states normalize to SS_EXT_PAINTED_* after proper prep and coating. Semi-gloss is default exterior window sheen.

adjacent_state_protection_rules.notes: RP casing is almost always already painted. Light tape at junction.
Siding masking for spray method only.

site_condition_rules.notes: HEIGHT IS A MAJOR MODIFIER for exterior windows. Per-window attribute. ground=1.00x, ladder=1.35x, scaffold=1.60x.
Pre-1978 + lead-positive activates MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT and FAC_XWRP_RRP (2.0x). Windows are HIGH RISK for lead paint — friction surfaces.
MC >15% is STOP WORK for coating on that surface. Active moisture = do not proceed until source resolved.
Common on north-facing, shaded, near-ground windows. Must treat before any coating.

cross_spec_coordination.deduplication_note: MOD_RRP_EXT_CONTAINMENT is shared across all exterior RP specs — do not duplicate lead-safe tasks when running alongside SF_TRIM_EXT_RP or SF_DOOR_EXT_RP.
cross_spec_coordination.shared_session_note: Exterior window RP typically runs alongside SF_TRIM_EXT_RP (window casing). Power wash ownership per-elevation (U-003): if already done by another spec on same elevation, skip. Landscape/hardscape protection shared (U-004): first spec in elevation sequence owns setup.
coordination_notes: Caulk at frame-to-casing junction is THIS spec's responsibility (not trim spec).
Siding masking zone (ext_siding_adjacent) spray only. If siding RP also in scope, coordinate masking.
Height/access modifiers (FAC_EXT_ACCESS) are per-window attributes — one building may have ground-level and ladder/scaffold windows.
In RP, all adjacent surfaces (casing, sill, siding) are almost always already finished — protection is mandatory for BOTH spray and brush methods.

research_corrections.original_claim: RRP modifier is 1.40x on prep tasks
research_corrections.corrected_to: RRP modifier is 2.00x on prep tasks involving paint disturbance. Calibrated to 2.00x based on actual wet-scraping, HEPA vacuum, and containment maintenance overhead per EPA RRP procedural requirements.

research_corrections.original_claim: Environmental conditions (wind, sun, surface temp) should be estimation modifiers
research_corrections.corrected_to: Environmental conditions are NOT estimatable — unpredictable at bid time. Excluded from spec entirely.

research_corrections.original_claim: Coating ID test (latex vs alkyd) is needed for exterior window RP
research_corrections.corrected_to: Coating ID test is NOT needed for exterior RP windows. Exterior paint has been predominantly 100% acrylic latex since the 1980s. ASTM D3359 adhesion test provides sufficient information. Differentiates exterior from interior window RP where coating ID IS needed.
research_corrections.source: Research analysis — exterior vs interior coating history

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup (ground protection + glass mask + hardware + weatherstrip + sill/casing/siding protect + equipment) -> RRP containment (if pre-1978) -> Assess (condition/adhesion/chalk/moisture/rot/glazing/sash) -> Prep (power wash + dry 24-48h + mildew treat + chalk remediation + scrape/feather + degloss/scuff + caulk + glazing repair + wood hardener + cladding prep + dust clean) -> Prime (cladding-specific spot prime + state-driven general prime) -> Interstage -> Finish 1 (brush/spray + muntin detail) -> Interstage -> Finish 2 (brush/spray + muntin detail) -> [DH: sash reverse + dry posture + periodic move + lubricate channels] -> Final inspect + Touch-up -> Glass cleanup -> Masking removal -> Protection teardown -> Hardware/weatherstrip reinstall -> Customer walkthrough + Cure advisory -> Equipment clean. [24-48 hr return: Sash break + glass scrape if not done]
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO painting over MC >15% (STOP WORK). NO skipping chalk-binding primer on SS_EXT_CHALKING. NO liquid mask on Low-E glass. NO roll application on windows. NO skipping interstage sanding — all tiers. NO closing sashes before full cure (7-14 days exterior). NO RRP without containment. NO scraping without feathering.

relationships.notes: First exterior window RP spec. Combined prime+finish. NC exterior window is sibling spec with significant task transfer (38 DIRECT + 8 MODIFIED). Interior window RP uses TSK_WNRP_* prefix — no collision.
